Trace this precisely through `useMegaMenuMotion.ts` and `list-menu-popover.tsx`'s actual reducer/effect code and say whether the race is real, whether any existing guard prevents it, and whether the 14 tests in `useMegaMenuMotion.test.ts` exercise this specific interleaving (they operate on the reducer in isolation, per the original finding — confirm or refute that gap).

3. **useHeaderNav fetch-failure doc/behavior mismatch.** Claim: `useHeaderNav.ts`'s `@returns` doc (around line 45-49) says `items` is `undefined` on fetch failure, but the implementation (~line 78-82) always returns `[]` once `isLoading` is false, including on error, and neither `list-menu.tsx` nor `drawer-menu/index.tsx` reads `isError` at all in non-test code. Verify the doc text, the implementation, and grep all non-test files for real `isError` usage.

4. **Stale "not wired" doc comments.** Claim: `header/headerTypes.ts` (~line 17-21), `header/leftBar/index.tsx` (~line 19, 23), and `header/rightBar/index.tsx` (~line 79-80, 84) all contain comments saying `menuExpanded`/`onClose`/`onBack` are "not wired to any real mega-menu/drawer state on this branch," but `header/index.tsx` (~line 156-203) demonstrably wires real state (`useHeaderMenuExpandedState`, `isMegaMenuOpen`/`MegaMenuOpenContext` driven by `list-menu.tsx`'s `activeItemId`). Confirm both the stale comment text and the real wiring.

5. **Stale navGroup.js comment.** Claim: `scripts/contentful/content-types/headerNavItem.js` (~line 29-31) says `navGroup` "has no local file in this content-types/ directory yet," but `scripts/contentful/content-types/navGroup.js` is a real, complete file created by this same PR. Confirm both.

8. **Nested `<nav>` landmark regression.** Claim: `header/leftBar/index.tsx` (~line 99) wraps `children` in `<chakra.nav __css={styles.nav}>`, and at tablet+ `children` resolves to `<ListMenu>`, which itself renders `<nav id="list-menu" aria-label="Main navigation">` (`list-menu.tsx` ~line 77) — producing a `<nav>` nested inside another `<nav>`. Claim also says the OLD header (at base commit 269d5d4) wrapped the same children in a plain `<Box>`, not a `<nav>`, so this is a new regression. Verify both the current nesting and the base-commit comparison (`git show 269d5d40149b9947111dd87e78d37b92fccd4c99:overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx` or wherever the old wrapping lived).

9. **PopoverFooter onClick on non-interactive element.** Claim: `rightBar/index.tsx` (~line 304) has `<PopoverFooter onClick={handleSignout} ...>` with no `role`/keyboard handling of its own, but the real interactive element is an inner `<Button>` (~line 306) whose click bubbles up. Confirm the structure and assess independently whether this is a live keyboard-trap risk or genuinely low-impact as the original finding claims.

10. **`/login` duplicated literal.** Claim: `header/index.tsx` (~line 215, `navigate('/login')`) and `drawer-menu/index.tsx` (~line 24, `const SIGN_IN_HREF = '/login'`) both hardcode the same route with no shared constant. 11. **SFCC-96/97 mega-menu/drawer work is separable, not load-bearing for SFCC-52/746.** Claim: `list-menu/list-menu.tsx` (~90-122) branches on `columns` count — zero columns renders a plain `ZimmNavItem` link, no mega-menu machinery — and `scripts/contentful/content-types/headerNavItem.js` (~33-39) makes `columns` optional specifically to support flat-nav-only configuration; separately, `drawer-menu/index.tsx`'s L1 nav (`DrawerMenuL1Nav`, ~54-79) alone satisfies vertical-categories-plus-footer-links without any dependency on L2 drill-down (`DrawerMenuL2Nav`, ~86-119). Verify both code paths directly and confirm the claimed independence is real (i.e., check whether L1 truly has zero runtime dependency on L2/drill-down state to render correctly).

12. **`responsive/index.tsx` sitewide breakpoint change.** Claim: this PR adds a NEW override at `overrides/app/components/responsive/index.tsx` that changes the mobile/desktop split used by `HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile` from Chakra's default breakpoint (`lg`, 992px) to `md` (768px), and this override has app-wide blast radius (every consumer of those two exports, not just header/footer). Confirm the file is new (not present at base commit), confirm the actual breakpoint values in both the base Chakra default and this override, and grep the whole `overrides/` tree for how many distinct components import `HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile` to characterize the real blast radius (a count, not just "many").

13. **`globalStyles.ts` new `#app-main` rule.** Claim: `overrides/app/theme/globalStyles.ts` (~line 220-238) adds a new global CSS rule targeting `#app-main`, applying grid tokens (sourced from the Tier-1 `gridSystem.ts` edit) to the base `_app`'s main content area, site-wide. Confirm this is new (diff against base commit) and confirm it actually affects the main content area of every page, not just header/footer.

14. **Footer/Contentful files unrelated to SFCC-52/746/747/96/97.** Claim: this PR's diff includes `overrides/app/components/footer/footer.css.ts` (a 946px site-map-wrap breakpoint fix, last commit), `scripts/contentful/content-types/footerConfig.js` (+phoneLabel/whatsAppLabel/emailLabel), `scripts/contentful/content-types/footerNavGroup.js` (DELETED, unified into a new shared `navGroup.js`), and footer copy migrated into the `uiCopy` model alongside header copy — none of which are required by any of the 5 header/nav tickets. Confirm each file's presence/deletion in the diff and give your own independent read on whether each is plausibly footer-only/unrelated to the header work, or whether it's actually load-bearing for the header changes (e.g. does the header mega-menu genuinely require the shared `navGroup.js` unification, making the `footerNavGroup.js` deletion load-bearing rather than a stray footer edit?).

15. **Comment-count pattern check.** Across findings 4, 5, and (from a separate reviewer) a stale logo-height comment in `header/index.tsx` claiming "66px" where the shipped value is actually "74px" (HEADER_LOGO_SX ~line 45-56) — confirm this fourth stale-comment instance too, so I can characterize whether "comments not updated as the branch evolved" is a real recurring pattern (4 instances) versus coincidence.

For each of the 15, give: verdict (CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE/UNSUPPORTED), a one-line reason citing file:line, and — for anything not CONFIRMED — exactly what would settle it. Do not edit any code. Report only.

Author: TimLavelle <tim+1@lavelle.bio>

    fix(header): address CodeRabbit PR #65 findings — focus, activation, motion, layout
    
    Five real findings from CodeRabbit's latest PR review round, each fixed
    with a regression test:
    
    - drawer-menu: L1<->L2 depth swap never moved focus, so it silently
      dropped to document.body and keyboard users restarted tabbing from
      the top of the drawer. Each panel now carries a ref + tabIndex={-1}
      and gets focused on every depth change (WCAG 2.2 AA).
    - list-menu-trigger: the visible mega-menu label renders as a <button>
      when the item has no href, but had no click handler, so Enter/Space
      on it did nothing (only pointer hover opened the menu). Wired onOpen
      as its click handler for the no-href case.
    - useMegaMenuMotion: hovering or closing a different item while the
      current one was still 'expanding' routed through the same contentOut
      fade as an already-open switch — but content isn't visible yet during
      'expanding', so the opacity transition this relies on for
      transitionend never fires, and the phase machine got stuck in
      contentOut forever. Both actions now handle 'expanding' directly.
    - megaMenuContent.css.ts: promoImageWrapper had no flexShrink at the
      desktop breakpoint, so panel's row layout could shrink the 862px
      promo image below its declared width if sections + gap didn't fit.
    - toMegaMenuItem: twoColumnLayout on a single-section group produced
      an empty second column via splitEvenly([section], 2) — now only
      splits when there's more than one section.
    
    Verified via tsc, full Vitest (526 tests), audit:tokens, and a
    real-browser test-storybook run against every touched story.

content.text:
## Verification results — PR #65, 15 claims

Methodology: read every cited file directly in the HEAD worktree, diffed against BASE (`269d5d4`) for every "new/changed" assertion, grepped the full `overrides/` tree (and, where the mechanism required it, the base `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app` tree) rather than trusting the cited scope, and checked git history/blame on the specific lines for claims 2 and 15. All line numbers below are what I read directly, not copied from the claims.

---

**1. Dead responsive-image pipeline — CONFIRMED**
`overrides/app/utils/contentfulImage.ts` defines `buildContentfulResponsiveImage`/`ContentfulResponsiveImage`/`avifSrcSet`/`webpSrcSet`. Grepping all of `overrides/app/components`, `overrides/app/utils`, `overrides/app/pages` finds zero consumers outside the function's own file and its own test (`contentfulImage.test.ts`). `megaMenuContent/index.tsx:152` and `drawer-menu/index.tsx:223` both render `<Image src={promoImage.src} ... />`, and `resolveImageEntry.ts:29` shows `promoImage.src` is literally `asset.fields.file.url` — the raw Contentful asset URL with no query string at all. The pipeline is fully dead code today.

**2. Mega-menu stuck-open edge case — CONFIRMED**, with an important refinement.
Traced the full path: `useMegaMenuMotion.ts`'s `CLOSE` case for `phase === 'expanding'` (lines 65-67) jumps straight to `'collapsing'`. In `list-menu-popover.tsx`, `useTransitionSafeValue` (lines 38-57) defers the real `setValue` by two `requestAnimationFrame`s. If `CLOSE` lands before that double-rAF resolves, `value` is still at its pre-HOVER default ('0fr'), the new target recomputed for `'collapsing'` is *also* `'0fr'` — so the DOM's `grid-template-rows` never actually changes, no CSS transition fires, `onTransitionEnd` never fires, `onCollapseComplete` is never dispatched, and the reducer never reaches `COLLAPSE_COMPLETE` — `activeItemId` stays non-null forever. I confirmed the visible symptom too: `header/index.tsx:160-169`'s `isMegaMenuOpen` is driven only by `list-menu.tsx:59-65`'s `activeItemId`-gated effect, and `rightBar/index.tsx:175-185` renders the "Close" text+X control whenever `menuExpanded === 'fullSwap'` (i.e., `isMegaMenuOpen`) — so the described end state (Close control shown, panel invisible) is real. Notably, `git show 13ce33e` shows the *exact* `CLOSE`-during-`'expanding'`→`'collapsing'` code path was added by a prior CodeRabbit-fix commit for a *related but different* bug (the opacity/content-fade side of the same problem) — that fix correctly handles content-fade but has no visibility into `useTransitionSafeValue`'s separate double-rAF deferral, so this height-side gap survived it.
Refinement: `useMegaMenuMotion.test.ts` has **13** `test()` blocks, not 14 (verified by count and by reading the whole file) — minor factual correction, doesn't affect the substance. All 13 operate via `renderHook`+reducer only, confirmed. I also checked `list-menu-popover.test.tsx`, which the original finding didn't cite — it *does* test CSS/rAF behavior (including the double-rAF deferral itself, lines 265-270), but every case renders a single static `motionPhase` prop; none rerenders from `'expanding'` to `'collapsing'` within the same test, so it doesn't hit this interleaving either. No test at any layer exercises it.

**3. useHeaderNav fetch-failure doc/behavior mismatch — CONFIRMED**
`useHeaderNav.ts:46` doc: `` `items` is `undefined` while loading, on fetch failure, or when no entry resolves``. Implementation, lines 78-82: `isLoading ? undefined : resolved ? filterByRegion(...) : []`. On error, `useQuery` settles `isLoading=false` with `data` still `undefined`, so `resolved` is `undefined` and `items` resolves to `[]`, not `undefined`. Grepped all non-test files in `overrides/app` for `isError`: only `useHeaderNav.ts` (defines/returns it) and `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (unrelated `isProductError`/`isCategoryError`). `list-menu.tsx` and `drawer-menu/index.tsx` read neither.

**4. Stale "not wired" doc comments — CONFIRMED**
`headerTypes.ts:17-21` and `leftBar/index.tsx:18-19,22` and `rightBar/index.tsx:79-80,84` all state the values are "not wired to any real mega-menu/drawer state on this branch." `header/index.tsx:160-203` demonstrably wires real state: `isMegaMenuOpen`/`MegaMenuOpenContext` (fed by `list-menu.tsx`'s `activeItemId` via `useMegaMenuOpenReporter`) and `useHeaderMenuExpandedState`, combined into `menuExpanded`/`onCloseMenu` and passed at `header/index.tsx:231` (`<LeftBar ... menuExpanded={menuExpanded} onBack={handleBack}>`) and `:248-249` (`<RightBar ... menuExpanded={menuExpanded} onClose={onCloseMenu} />`).

**5. Stale navGroup.js comment — CONFIRMED**
`headerNavItem.js:29-31`: "`navGroup` is authored on a separate branch ... and has no local file in this content-types/ directory yet." `scripts/contentful/content-types/navGroup.js` is a full, complete file, added by this same PR (`git diff --name-status` shows `A scripts/contentful/content-types/navGroup.js`).

**6. list-menu barrel misexport — CONFIRMED**
`overrides/app/components/list-menu/index.ts` doesn't exist at base (`ls` fails on the base worktree). Line 3: `export { ListMenuPopover } from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/list-menu/list-menu-popover';` — the base path. The local override `list-menu-popover.tsx` is 282 lines vs. base's 80, and is substantively different (full motion-phase integration, keyboard nav, `useTransitionSafeValue`). Exhaustive grep of every `ListMenuPopover` reference in `overrides/` (including tests/stories) shows the real consumer, `list-menu.tsx:3`, and the test file `list-menu-popover.test.tsx:7`, both import directly from `'./list-menu-popover'`, bypassing the barrel entirely — so the bug is currently latent (no live consumer hits it) but is a real, confirmed defect in the barrel's source.

**7. Missing `_focusVisible` on several new IconButtons — CONFIRMED**
Grepped `leftBar/index.tsx` and `rightBar/index.tsx` in full for `_focusVisible`: zero matches in either file, confirming none of the 6 cited IconButtons (leftBar hamburger `:83`; rightBar tablet search `:205`, account trigger `:242`, mobile search `:387`, mobile bag `:427`, mobileL2 close `:452`) sets it. Contrast confirmed: `zimmNavItem.css.ts:47-51` (`light` variant) and `:55-59` (`inverse` variant) set it explicitly; `zimmSearchInput/index.tsx:103-106` (the clear button, a direct Chakra prop, not in `zimmSearchInput.css.ts` — worth noting since the claim didn't name the file) sets it explicitly; `header.css.ts:73-74` (`logoButton` part) sets it explicitly (`_focusVisible: { outline: 0 }`, paired with `_focus: { boxShadow: 'outline' }`).

**8. Nested `<nav>` landmark regression — CONFIRMED**
`leftBar/index.tsx:99`: `<chakra.nav __css={styles.nav}>{children}</chakra.nav>`. `children` resolves to `<ListMenu>` at tablet+ (via `header/index.tsx:231-233` forwarding Header's own `children`, which base `_app/index.jsx` sets to `<ListMenu>`), and `list-menu.tsx:77` renders `<nav id="list-menu" aria-label="Main navigation" ...>` as `ListMenuView`'s own root — a `<nav>` nested inside a `<nav>`, the outer one carrying no `aria-label` at all. Base-commit comparison: `git show 269d5d4:overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx` line 236 shows the old header wrapped `{children}` in `<Box {...styles.bodyContainer}>{children}</Box>` — a plain `Box`, not a `nav`. This is a genuine new regression introduced by this PR's LeftBar/RightBar split.

**9. PopoverFooter onClick on non-interactive element — CONFIRMED** (structure), independent risk read: **low-impact, not a keyboard trap**.
`rightBar/index.tsx:304`: `<PopoverFooter onClick={handleSignout} cursor={...}>`, inner `<Button variant="unstyled" {...headerStyles.signout} isDisabled={isSigningOut}>` at `:306` with no `onClick` of its own. Confirmed at the library level: `node_modules/@chakra-ui/popover/dist/popover-footer.js:42-52` shows `PopoverFooter` is literally `chakra.footer` with `...props` spread — no role, no keyboard handling added. My own assessment: this is *not* a keyboard trap — Chakra's `Button` renders a real native `<button>`, so Enter/Space while it's focused produces a genuine `click` DOM event that bubbles to the ancestor `<footer onClick>` exactly like a mouse click, so keyboard activation works correctly today. The real (minor) defect is scope creep — clicking anywhere in the footer's padding/Divider area, not just the button, also triggers sign-out — a code-smell/maintainability risk (fragile if the child ever stops being a native interactive element) rather than a live a11y bug.

**10. `/login` duplicated literal — CONFIRMED**
`header/index.tsx:215` (`navigate('/login')`) and `drawer-menu/index.tsx:24` (`const SIGN_IN_HREF = '/login';`) are the only two files in `overrides/app` containing the literal `'/login'` (grep confirmed, tests/stories excluded). `overrides/app/routes.tsx` exists but contains no reference to "login" at all (case-insensitive grep, zero matches) — it's a route-table file, not a constants module, so no existing shared constant was available for either site to use.

**11. SFCC-96/97 mega-menu/drawer work is separable — CONFIRMED**
`list-menu.tsx:90-122`: `itemsCount > 0 ? <ListMenuPopover .../> : <ZimmNavItem label={label} href={href} .../>` — a zero-columns item renders a plain link with zero mega-menu machinery invoked. `headerNavItem.js:32-39`: `columns` field is `required: false`, with `:28` documenting "0 columns = direct link via `href`". `drawer-menu/index.tsx:54-79` (`DrawerMenuL1Nav`) takes only `items`/`onDrillInto`/`styles` — no dependency on `activeItem`/`isDrilledIn` — and is rendered in `DrawerMenuView`'s `else` branch (`:187-190`), fully independent of L2 (`DrawerMenuL2Nav`, `:86-119`, which only renders in the sibling `isDrilledIn && activeItem` branch, `:183-186`). The footer wishlist/account/sign-in links (`:195-216`) render whenever `!isDrilledIn`, also independent of L2. Code-level separability is real and directly verified; I can't independently verify the Jira ticket-to-code mapping (which ticket literally owns which behavior) from source alone.

**12. `responsive/index.tsx` sitewide breakpoint change — CONFIRMED, and broader than the claim states.**
File is new (`ls` fails at base). Base `node_modules/.../components/responsive/index.jsx:17,31` hardcodes `lg` (this project's own `theme.breakpoints.lg = '62em'` in `gridSystem.ts:16`, i.e. 992px, unchanged from Chakra's stock default). The new override (`responsive/index.tsx:10`) sets `MOBILE_DESKTOP_SPLIT = 'md'` (`'48em'` = 768px). Grepping `overrides/app` alone for real (non-comment) JSX usage of `HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile` finds exactly **one** active consumer file: `product-view/index.tsx` (2 usages, lines 712/718/908/914) — `header/index.tsx:273`'s reference is commented out. But because this repo's `ccExtensibility` resolver redirects *every* import of `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/responsive` to this override at real-build time, not just imports from within `overrides/`, I additionally grepped the base template tree and found **9 more real, active, un-overridden consumers** that will silently inherit the new 768px split: `_app/index.jsx` (root shell), `product-item/index.jsx`, `search/index.jsx`, `search/partials/search-suggestions-section.jsx`, `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx`, `hooks/use-dnt-notification.js`, `pages/checkout/partials/checkout-footer.jsx`, `pages/checkout-one-click/partials/one-click-checkout-footer.jsx`, and `pages/product-list/index.jsx` (PLP). So the true blast radius (10 distinct files: PDP, PLP, product tiles, search, search-suggestions, bonus-product modal, DNT notice, both checkout footers, and the app shell) is materially larger than a naive `overrides/`-only grep would show — the claim's "app-wide, not just header/footer" framing understates rather than overstates the real scope.

**13. `globalStyles.ts` new `#app-main` rule — CONFIRMED**
`git diff` confirms pure addition: `zimmAppMain` (lines 228-238) and its registration `'#app-main': zimmAppMain` are new, no removal. `node_modules/.../components/_app/index.jsx:461-468` shows `<Box as="main" id="app-main" role="main" ...>{children}</Box>` wrapping every route's page content, positioned as a sibling between Header and Footer in the un-forked base app shell — so this rule genuinely applies grid-margin/max-width tokens to the literal main-content wrapper of every page in the app, not just header/footer.

**14. Footer/Contentful files unrelated to SFCC-52/746/747/96/97 — CONFIRMED for 3 of 4 items; UNSUPPORTED for one.**
- `footer.css.ts` (946px fix): confirmed as the tip commit (`10eb79d fix(footer): wrap site-map columns under subscribe until 946px` — matches `git log` head exactly). No evident header coupling.
- `footerConfig.js` +phoneLabel/whatsAppLabel/emailLabel: confirmed via diff. `ContactIconRow`/`zimmContactIconRow` (the consumer) has zero header call sites (grepped) — genuinely footer-only.
